pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0136 preview residency and streaming
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements project-scoped preview CPU/GPU residency, asynchronous preview renderer warm-up, frame-budgeted GPU uploads, atomic reimport promotion, startup stale-catalog recovery, ADR 0135 reclaim recovery, and revision-stamped Animation Set choice caching for ADR 0136.

Animation Preview now performs only cheap file-stamp checks in its immediate UI path and reuses parsed clip choices until the Animation Set changes.
